::: {#exr-smooth-loss}

#### A rule with a smooth loss

Swap the 0-or-1 rule for a soft version,
which gives each image a probability of being a 1:

$$p = \sigmoidf{x - c},$$

where

- $x$ is the image's center ink,
- $c$ is the cutoff, the rule's one [parameter](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter),
- $\sigmoid$ is the [logistic function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/logistic-regression.html#exm-logistic-function), $\sigmoidf{z} = 1 / (1 + \expf{-z})$,
- and $p$ is the probability the rule gives that the image is a 1.

Among the 0s and 1s,
plot the mean [log loss](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/logistic-regression.html#def-log-loss) of this rule against $c$,
over the cutoffs of @exr-train-on-errors.
Could gradient descent find the best cutoff on this curve?

:::
